quotations.old_english: Ealle geseónde mé hlehtredon l̄ tǣldun [mé]
Gif þū mid þan þeáwe tǣlendra mé hleahtrige

source_text: hleahtrian; p. ode To laugh to scorn, deride :-- Ealle geseónde m&e-long; hlehtredon &l-bar; tæ-long;ldun [m&e-long;] omnes uidentes me deriserunt me, Ps. L. 21, 8. Gif þ&u-long; mid þan þeáwe tæ-long;lendra m&e-long; hleahtrige, Guth. Gr. 101, 23. (v. hleahtor ; I. 2.)
